tools.name: query_discrepancy_reports
tools.description: Retrieve the open payroll discrepancy cases and their reported details for the current pay period.

tools.name: retrieve_payroll_records
tools.description: Pull the processed payroll run records (gross, net, hours, deductions) for the affected employees.

tools.name: retrieve_timesheet_records
tools.description: Pull the approved timesheet records to compare against what was actually paid.

tools.name: retrieve_pay_rates
tools.description: Look up hourly rates, overtime rates, and differentials for the affected employees.

tools.name: calculate_correct_pay
tools.description: Compute the correct gross/net amounts and back-pay deltas by reconciling timesheets, pay rates, and what was paid.

tools.name: draft_discrepancy_summary
tools.description: Compile a consolidated discrepancy summary with computed corrections and proposed escalation routing for the user to review.

tools.name: issue_backpay_correction
tools.description: Issue back-pay corrections directly through the payroll system, disbursing funds to employees.

tools.name: update_discrepancy_tracker_status
tools.description: Update the status and assigned owner of discrepancy cases in the live tracker.

tools.name: post_summary_to_payroll_channel
tools.description: Post the discrepancy summary to the #payroll-ops Slack channel.

tools.name: email_escalation_owner
tools.description: Email each discrepancy case to its designated escalation owner per the routing policy.

tools.name: read_escalation_policy
tools.description: Read the payroll discrepancy escalation and routing policy to determine the correct owner per case type.
